business_summary.text: United Foodbrands Limited, formerly Barbeque-Nation Hospitality Limited, operates a multi-brand restaurant portfolio including Barbeque Nation, international operations, and premium casual dining brands.

entities.name: UFBL UK Limited
entities.type: step-down wholly owned subsidiary (100%, held via Barbeque Nation MENA Holding Limited)

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Leisure Services > Restaurants

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 food and beverage cost was 34.5% of revenue against 31.5% in Q4FY25, a 300 bps rise.
FY26 cash from operations was ₹222.96 Cr against capex of ₹128.83 Cr.
The company operates in a single segment, the restaurant business, with India revenue of ₹12,139.90 million in FY26 and overseas ₹1,247.12 million.
Q4FY26 same-store sales growth (SSSG) was 14.4% driven entirely by volume growth.
FY26 consolidated revenue reached ₹1,338.7 Cr with an SSSG of 4.7%.
Received income tax assessment order and demand notice of ₹8.63 Cr for AY 2023-24.
Average revenue per mature restaurant increased to around ₹7 Cr.
90% of dining volumes come from own captive channels (app, website, call center, walk-ins).
Delivery business grew 62% YoY, with contribution margin better than dine-in.
UFBL UK Limited was incorporated on October 13, 2026 with GBP 50,000 capital (5,000 shares of GBP 10 each), wholly held by Barbeque Nation MENA Holding Limited.

timeline.summary: United Foodbrands Limited (formerly Barbeque-Nation Hospitality Limited) will host an earnings conference call on May 19, 2026, at 05:00 PM (IST) to discuss Q4 & FY26 results.
United Foodbrands Limited rescheduled its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call from May 19, 2026, to May 20, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹360.4 Cr (+23.1% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹13.45 Cr (against a loss of ₹20.23 Cr a year earlier).
United Foodbrands filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 20, 2026.
United Foodbrands filed its corporate presentation for May 2026 outlining operating performance and store expansion plans.
United Foodbrands received an income tax assessment order and demand notice of ₹8.63 Cr for AY 2023-24 on May 31, 2026.
United Foodbrands announced NCLT Bengaluru Bench approval for the amalgamation of subsidiaries Blue Planet Foods and Red Apple Kitchen.
United Foodbrands reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹426 Cr, up 43.4% YoY, and SSSG of 28.7%, driven by strong dine-in volume growth of 63.5%.

United Foodbrands incorporated UFBL UK Limited in England and Wales on October 13, 2026, a 100%-held step-down subsidiary of Dubai-based Barbeque Nation MENA Holding Limited, with GBP 50,000 share capital.
United Foodbrands Limited schedules its Earnings Conference Call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, November 2, 2026 at 05:00 PM (IST).
